newIssuerOwnedResolution.normalLayout: The current official guide establishes large-scale use at 2,480 seats: 2,456 fixed numbered seats including 12 score seats, 8 unnumbered wheelchair positions, and 16 unnumbered parent-child-room seats.
newIssuerOwnedResolution.wheelchair: The eight wheelchair positions are explicitly inside the 2,480 total and outside the 2,456 fixed-seat subtotal. The current map draws them as two unnumbered four-position spaces behind 2F row 11, so there are no numbered replacement or withdrawal seats.
newIssuerOwnedResolution.variants: Medium-scale use is 1,880 seats and closes part of 4F plus the 5F front through the movable-wall/use-area configuration. Current meeting material also permits front seats to be removed, covered, or left in place. These are not mixed into the normal full-layout candidate.
newIssuerOwnedResolution.sourceDate: The current 1F-3F and 4F-5F official maps have PDF creation dates 2024-05-29 and 2024-04-12. The official rental page identifies the current guide as revised 2026-03-03; its PDF metadata is 2026-03-27. The current meeting sheet is marked 20260701版 with 2026-06-30 metadata. These current sources supersede the stale 2018 useguide for pit semantics.
newIssuerOwnedResolution.pitContradiction: The current official map and 2026 guide state a 176-seat orchestra-pit reduction and label rows 1-5 as the pit. The printed IDs in those rows total 177: row 1 seats 20-31 (12), row 2 seats 5-30 and 32-46 (41), rows 3 and 4 seats 4-47 (44 each), and row 5 seats 8-43 (36). No issuer-owned key identifies one ID outside the stated 176.

releaseBlockerRedefined: The verified production artifacts are internally releaseable, but release-seed-v1 still defines readiness as promotion or formal closure of every curated target and region requirement. Its 48 targets include only 7 productions and 41 non-production dispositions; all 14 release regions remain below their target count. The blocker is therefore the seed manifest's exhaustive coverage/governance contract, not a regression or validation defect in the 59-venue production database.

releaseOptions.releaseCurrentVerifiedSet: Ship 59 verified venues / 80,750 seats with all holds disclosed. This has the lowest engineering and evidence cost, but requires an explicit governance change from 48-of-48 seed promotion to an approved verified-set release with documented exclusions.
releaseOptions.continueExpansion: Continue venue acquisition to improve geographic breadth. Yield is uncertain because 19 P2 holds require new issuer evidence and four require explicit schema/policy redesign; discovering new source-complete candidates is likely cheaper than repeatedly escalating closed holds.
